criteria.title: Implement a bounded opcode dispatch loop with explicit stack effects and checked int32 operations.
criteria.task: Trace every stack transition for checked add/subtract/multiply/divide, including negative division, zero divisor and INT32_MIN/-1. Implement admission before the C operation and test exact neighboring valid results.
